あらすじ

When a young latina boy wants to take revenge on his bitch stepmother, the hell get lose! A game about submission and hypnosis. Did he take more than he can handle? Submit your stepmom and make her do the wild things… Several choice and different paths with some animated scenes! Be careful how you choose the path and be careful not to succumb to your lust, otherwise you may end up in one of the shorter, different endings of the game! Can you bypass all the obstacles and find your way into the best story?
